text:
tess: Heads up — us-west shared pool at ~95% slot utilization for last 40m. Small tenants seeing 200–600ms queue spikes, some tail p99s 1.2s. Cross-region failovers from eu-west seem to be contributing.

raj: saw similar in dashboards. Any kube churn or KV thrash?

maria: there was a small node reboot event 15m ago. Autoscaler logged quota failures: ```autoscaler: error: insufficient quota for 4 gpus``` so we didn't top up.

liam: suggestion: watermark-based pacer that gates admission per-tenant based on cluster_free_ratio and a tenant watermark. Soft watermark allows occasional bursts, critical watermark rejects/queues. Refill tokens proportional to tenant_commit * cluster_free_ratio.

tess: can you sketch a config? want something that avoids sudden hard caps (noisy neighbor) but also allows small interactive tenants to keep snappy.

liam: sketch:
```yaml
pacer:
  tenant_bucket_size: 50
  soft_watermark: 0.25   # fraction of tenant_commit
  critical_watermark: 0.9
  refill_policy:
    base_rate: tenant_commit * 0.1
    scale_with_cluster_free_ratio: true
  cross_region_lending:
    enabled: true
    min_free_fraction: 0.2
    max_lent_slots_per_region: 10
```
This means when cluster_free_ratio is low, refill slows; when another region has >20% free, it may lend slots (best-effort) to reduce queue spikes.

nora: lending is neat but increases egress & inter-region network latencies. We should account for cost and tail effects.

autoscaler-bot: scale-event: request(4 gpus) -> failed (quota). Logged ticket #PLAT-3421

raj: another angle: lease stewardship for KV sessions so a single tenant can't hold many warm KV sessions idle. Have timed leases and graceful preemption with shorttime reclaim to reduce hotshot sessions.

maria: ops plan: canary in eu-west. Enable pacer on 10% of shared pools; ramp from 1% to 10% over 30m; collect metrics: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 queue, token_debt, cross_region_lent_slots, egress-cost-estimate.

tess: I'll write RFC + PoC PR. success criteria: reduce small-tenant p99 queue by >=40% while keeping cluster throughput change <5% and egress cost delta <2%.

liam: add metrics: tenant.token_balance, tenant.recent_burst_count, cluster.free_fraction; alert if token_balance negative > 5m.

maria: ack, will provision test account and prepare quota escalation path.

tess: thanks — I'll post the RFC draft later today. :thumbsup:
